Suitable for out-of-core processing when combined with partitioning [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly describes a partitioning mechanism in `src/svo_builder/partitioner.cpp`. The function `estimate_partitions` calculates the number of partitions required to fit the voxel grid into the available `memory_limit`. If the required memory exceeds the limit, it increases the partition count to reduce the memory footprint per partition. This logic is specifically designed to handle scenarios where the data does not fit in-core, thereby enabling out-of-core processing by splitting the workload into manageable chunks (partitions). The claim that it is 'suitable for out-of-core processing when combined with partitioning' is directly supported by this code.
